name: The post-2014 horror wave
era: Debuts 2014–2019 · your deepest cohort by far
have: Have: Eggers, Aster, Peele, Rose Glass, Ti West, Jennifer Kent, David Robert Mitchell, Zach Cregger, Osgood Perkins, Fargeat, Brandon Cronenberg, Alex Garland.
missing: Missing: **Julia Ducournau** (Raw, Titane) is the only major name absent — and Raw is the one most like The Substance, which you logged.

name: The Korean New Wave
missing: Missing: **Memories of Murder**, **The Handmaiden**, **The Wailing**, plus Kim Jee-woon (I Saw the Devil) and Lee Chang-dong (Burning). Bong and Park are exact contemporaries who came up together — treating them as one project is more efficient than one at a time.

name: The class of 1999
era: Fincher, Jonze & Kaufman, PTA, the Wachowskis — all peaking in one year
have: Have: Fight Club, Being John Malkovich (4½), The Matrix.
missing: Missing: **Magnolia**. Three of the four are logged and it's the one that isn't — and it's the PTA closest to A Serious Man's sense of an indifferent universe assigning punishments.

name: Norwegian discomfort
missing: Missing: **Sick of Myself** and **Dream Scenario**, both Borgli. You rated his newest film 4 and haven't touched the other two — the easiest unclaimed win on the page.

name: 70s New Hollywood paranoia
era: Lumet, Pakula, Roeg, Coppola · the ancestor of half this profile

missing: Missing almost entirely, and it's upstream of Fincher, Villeneuve, the Safdies and Nolan at once. Start with **Dog Day Afternoon** and **Don't Look Now** — both under two hours, both fast.

name: Ridley Scott's own line
